title: Shelter health referral
description: A referral from a shelter health services lead: the need described by function, urgency and where the person is referred, using an exercise reference. It gives no diagnosis detail beyond what the receiving service needs and no real patient identifier. Everything is fictional and marked as an exercise product; a real helpline number never appears without the EXERCISE marking, and no real person or address is used.

subtitle.description: Line under the organization: unit, site, period

urgency.description: ROUTINE, SAME DAY or URGENT as a word

need.description: What the person needs, described by function
examples: Needs a refill of daily blood pressure medicine left at home and a check of a leg wound dressing.

followUp.description: How the shelter will follow up
examples: Health lead will call the clinic at 23:00 and update the manager.
